# Niles

> Rust CLI that runs Claude Code, Codex and pi as one team in tmux. Unix only.

## Set up

Install Niles with Homebrew, the shell installer, or Cargo (see the README), then have the user
run `niles` in the repository. The first run offers registration; setup in the project pane
detects agent CLIs, pins release-matched skills, and configures the manifest. Register later projects with `r`.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rhovian/niles/main/README.md): requirements, configuration, skills.
- [Suggested setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rhovian/niles/main/docs/setup.md): home view keys, status bar, theme.
- [Skill workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rhovian/niles/main/docs/skills.md)
- [Threat model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rhovian/niles/main/docs/security.md)
